target.title: improve(matrix): prove lifecycle parity across substrates
target.body:
Closes #101054

## What Problem This Solves

Matrix transport tests need one lifecycle contract for cold start, idempotent start, restart, stop, and resume so the same behavioral scenarios can run against both the Docker-backed Tuwunel live driver and Crabline's Matrix channel driver.

## Why This Change Was Made

The architecture follows the existing selected-driver boundary and remains test-only:

1. `lifecycle.test-support.ts` owns only substrate-neutral state transitions and assertions. It knows that a runtime has a `baseUrl`, but knows nothing about Tuwunel or Crabline.
2. `tuwunel-lifecycle.test-support.ts` wraps the existing Matrix live-driver harness and preserves its resolved port across restart/resume. Its Docker proof is a `.live.test.ts` lane, so intentional live-test selection controls provisioning.
3. Crabline lifecycle proof lives beside `crabline-transport.ts` in QA Lab. It selects `{ channel: "matrix", channelDriver: "crabline" }` and starts through `createQaCrablineTransportAdapter`; the Matrix plugin contains no Crabline-specific implementation or policy.
4. `test-api.ts` is a private test surface. It is excluded from bundled plugin build entries, so the lifecycle helpers do not enter the Matrix runtime bundle.

The lifecycle contract permits a substrate to return a new endpoint after restart while proving the replaced endpoint is no longer reachable. The same five scenarios and Matrix differential probe run against both selected driver lanes.

## User Impact

No end-user Matrix runtime behavior, configuration, environment-variable surface, public package contents, or runtime bundle size changes. Maintainers gain executable lifecycle parity proof without duplicating Crabline transport ownership or introducing QA-named lifecycle concepts into the Matrix plugin.

## Evidence

- Exact pushed head: `056ad759e9cbfa5e09afb776f4b7588195689554`.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwwgyv67zt51fpc6hkehgyzm`:
  - `node scripts/test-live.mjs -- extensions/qa-matrix/src/substrate/lifecycle.live.test.ts` passed all five Tuwunel lifecycle scenarios.
  - `pnpm test extensions/qa-lab/src/crabline-transport.lifecycle.e2e.test.ts extensions/qa-matrix/src/substrate/lifecycle.test.ts` passed the adapter-owned Crabline five-scenario proof and three shared controller tests.
  - `pnpm check:changed` passed production/test typechecks, extension lint, dependency/package guards, database-first guard, runtime sidecar guard, and import-cycle checks.
- Guard warning proof: `node scripts/report-test-temp-creations.mjs` reports no new temp-directory migration warnings on this head.
- Bundle proof: the qa-matrix build graph contains only `index`, `cli`, and `runtime-api`; the lifecycle test support contributes 0 runtime entries. qa-matrix also has no public package artifacts.
- Production boundary check: the Matrix plugin has no Crabline lifecycle implementation; Crabline-specific setup is confined to the Crabline transport adapter test.
- Direct upstream contract inspection: Crabline `0.1.9` owns `startOpenClawCrablineAdapter`, Matrix provider probing, Matrix manifest/config translation, and adapter-owned inbound injection.
- Fresh autoreview thread `019f3914-9f0f-7c03-b921-561c56f18d26` completed with no accepted or actionable findings after preserving lifecycle body failures through Tuwunel cleanup.

Developed with AI assistance. A sanitized agent transcript is available but is not included without explicit approval.

### Current main QA Smoke status

- Rebasing onto `origin/main` was conflict-free; `git range-diff` shows all five task commits are patch-identical after rebase.
- Current main includes `b773f7981acde52a04e87129df2f9e8282a38f00` and its intentional revert `19491fe34c55260efd243ba30fa15bcf8508cb6a`; this PR does not reintroduce or work around that selector behavior.
- One exact local fallback characterization of the hosted QA Smoke CLI path on true current main selected 91 scenarios and stopped with the known upstream error: multiple channels `(telegram, matrix, slack, whatsapp)` require separate runs.
- Blacksmith Testbox capacity remained queued for the bounded post-rebase run; direct AWS fallback was unavailable because broker auth is not configured. Pre-rebase exact lifecycle Testbox proof remains valid because the rebase was patch-identical and conflict-free.

### Current main CI state

- Rebasing onto `origin/main` at `6bffda416614780b1b129891615b4a43cadb4080` was conflict-free and `git range-diff` shows all five task commits remain patch-identical.
- PR #101185 intentionally removes the automatic `QA Smoke CI` row, execution block, and artifact upload from `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; this PR does not modify selector or CI workflow files.
- The previously queued manual smoke characterization and its Testbox lease were stopped. No additional Testbox capacity was consumed.
- Narrow local fallback proof passed the Crabline lifecycle E2E test and all three lifecycle controller tests. The Tuwunel local live test could not run because this Mac Docker installation lacks the Compose plugin; the prior exact Linux Testbox proof remains valid because the task patch is identical after rebase.
